caseNameFull: McGrath, Attorney General, Successor to the Alien Property Custodian v. Nagano
attorneys: James D. Hill argued the cause fdr petitioner. With him on the brief.were Solicitor General. Perlman, Assistant Attorney General Baynton, George B. Searls and Irwin A. Seibel. Edward R. Johnston argued the cause and filed a brief for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The .judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
